cases.purpose: Verify -x stops recursion at a nested filesystem on a different device.
cases.oracle: Per-observation private user and mount namespace with owned tmpfs, independently checked lstat device and allocated-block accounting, GNU du with and without -x, and fresh inotify watches on the foreign mount and nested directory. Metadata-only and native traversal controls validate observation in each invocation.
cases.comparison: Setup retains candidate stdout, stderr and status plus complete inotify events from the same private mount. Metadata-only native stat must produce no foreign events and native du traversal must open both watched directories. Candidate -x must produce no foreign access/open events; unrestricted traversal must open both directories. Complete listing and exact accounting remain required. Setup and observer failures are setup ERROR; product mismatches are assessed FAIL. Primary must independently gate evidence on complete setup, control and raw diagnostics.
